title: Recording agent-registry observations never holds the coordination lock over 1 s
description: On a running test install seeded with 20 accounts and 50 sessions, POST /api/agent-registry/observe carrying every account's observations completes in under 1 s without holding the coordination lock, and master status names no observe request among coordination-lock holds over 1 s.

steps.name: observes all 20 accounts under 1 s without holding the coordination lock
